training.initialization: PyTorch default initialization; manual_seed immediately before CNN construction; bind runtime version
training.batch_algorithm: persistent NumPy PCG64; one permutation of 8192 ordered donor-major/treatment-minor examples each epoch; sequential complete batches, without replacement
training.epoch_extent: 15 complete epochs and first 160 batches of epoch 16
training.memory_limit_scope: Windows JobObject process committed memory, not RSS or GPU VRAM
training.repeat_policy: one fixed run; no alternative initialization or sampling seed trials

proposed_target_standardization.population: 256 unique fitting original native Q8 canonical targets only
proposed_target_standardization.degenerate_rule: Stop if any target standard deviation is nonfinite or <=1e-12; no dimension deletion or replacement
proposed_target_standardization.mse: Equal weight to each of four standardized target coordinates and each original/treatment

unresolved_before_seal: Complete cache array/normalizer validation and hash binding
limits: Configuration alone cannot authorize execution; train entry requires verified final seal. One fixed4000-step run; no held outcomes yet.
